title: Stale-Payoff Waiver on Overpayment Recoveries
content:
# Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda — Stale-Payoff Waiver Schedule for Overpayment Recoveries

**Schedule.** This schedule reads only the add-ons cancelled on or after the loss date: a Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans plan or a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract financed on the waiver's purchase deal. For each such add-on it takes the date its refund was last paid to the lienholder. The earlier of those dates is compared with the date the waiver's most recent paid GAP balance line was paid.

| Earlier refund date, compared with the date the paid line was paid | Amount waived from the overpayment |
|---|---|
| Before that date | 30.00 |
| On that date, or within the claim payment period after it | 15.00 |
| More than the claim payment period after it, or no such refund paid to the lienholder | nothing |

The claim payment period is 30 calendar days for every tier of the Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda. It is counted from the date the paid line was paid (day 0). The amount waived is set against the overpayment, but it never takes the reversal below one half of the overpayment.

### Dated cases (hypothetical)

The paid line was paid on Day 52.

- The plan's refund was last paid to the lienholder on Day 40: 30.00 is waived.
- Only the contract was cancelled after the loss, and its refund was last paid on Day 52: 15.00 is waived.
- The contract's refund was paid on Day 82, which is 30 days after: 15.00 is waived. If it was paid on Day 83, nothing is waived.
- The plan's refund was paid on Day 90 and the contract's on Day 47. The earlier date, Day 47, is before Day 52, so 30.00 is waived.
- The overpayment is 44.00 and 30.00 is to be waived. Half of the overpayment is 22.00, so the reversal is 22.00.
